paite: Huan, Hichi ahi a, a ni giat ni in Mosi in Aron leh a tapate leh Israel upate a sam a:
english: It happened on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

paite: Huan, Aron kiang ah, Khelh thoihna ding in bawngnou a pa leh a haltum thillat ding in belampa gensiatbei tuaktuak kai inla, TOUPA ma ah lan in.
english: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before Yahweh.

paite: Huan, Israel suante kiang ah, Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa, huan haltum thillat ding in bawngnou leh belamnou kum khat a upa tuaktuak gensiatbei chiat.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

paite: Leh bawngpa leh belampa TOUPA ma a lepna thillat a lat ding in hon kai unla; huan, sathau a mek tangbuang thillat toh: tuni in na kiang uah TOUPA a hong lang sin ahi, chi in hilh in, a chi a.
english: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”

paite: Huan, Mosi in thu a piak bang in kihoupihna puan inn kong ah a hon kai ua; huan, mi tengteng in a va naih ua, TOUPA ma ah a va ding uh.
english: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Yahweh.

paite: Huan, Mosi in, Hiai ahi na hih ding ua TOUPA'N thu a hon piak: huchi in TOUPA thupina na lak uah a hong lang ding, a chi a.
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do: and the glory of Yahweh shall appear to you.”

paite: Huan, Mosi in Aron kiang ah, Maitam hon naih inla, na khelh thoihnate, na haltum thillatte lan inla, nang a ding leh mipite a ding in kilemna bawl in: huan, mipite thillat pen lan inla, amau a ding in kilepna bawl in, TOUPA thupiak bang in, a chi a.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them; as Yahweh commanded.”

paite: Huan, Aron in maitam a va naih a, amah a tuam a khelh thoihna bawngnou a gou a.
english: So Aaron drew near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

paite: Huan, Aron tapate'n sisan a kiang ah a lan ua, sisan ah a khutzung a diah a, maitam kite ah a tat a, sisan pen maitam bul ah a sung a:
english: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:

paite: Khelh thoihna thaute, a kalte, a sin tuam pen lapte bel maitam tungah a hal a, TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in.
english: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan, a sa leh a vun dainawl ah a hal.
english: The flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

paite: Huan, haltum a thillat pen a gou a; Aron tapate'n sisan a pua ua, aman maitam kimvel in a theh.
english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

paite: Haltum thillat sabak khatkhat in a lu toh a pia ua, aman maitam ah a na hal a.
english: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burned them upon the altar.

paite: Huan, a sungkuate, a khete a sil a, maitam ah haltum thillat tungah a hal a.
english: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

paite: Huan, mipite thillat pen a lan a, mipite khelh thoihna kel a kai a, a gou a, a ma a mah bang in khelh thoihna di'n a lan hi.
english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

paite: Huan, haltum thillat a lan a, a dan bangbang in a lan hi.
english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

paite: Huan, tangbuang thillat a lan a, huailai a a pham khat a la a, zingsang lam a haltum thillat chih louh leng maitam ah a hal lai hi.
english: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.

paite: Huan, mipte a tuam dia lepna thillat kithoihna bawngpa leh elampa leng a gou a; huan, Aron tapate'n a sisan a pia ua, maitam a kimvel in a theh hi;
english: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar,

paite: Huan, bawngpa thau leh belampa thaute, a mei thau takte, a gilbohte, a kalte, a sintuam pen a lapte leng a pia ua:
english: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver:

paite: A thau pen a awm tungah a koih ua, huan, aman a thau pen maitam ah a hal hi.
english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar:

paite: Huan, a awm leh a liang tak lam pen Aron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in a vei a; Mosi thupiak bang in.
english: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.

paite: Huan, Aron in mipi lam ah a ban a zak a, a vek un vual a zawl a; huan, khelh thoihna leh haltum thillat leh, lemna thillat a lat khit in a hon pai suk.
english: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

paite: Huan, Mosi leh Aron kihoupihna puan inn ah a va lut ua, huan, a hong pawtkhe nawn ua, mipite a vualzawl ua; huan, TOUPA thupina mi tengteng ah a hong lang hi.Huan, TOUPA ma a kipan mei a hong pawtkhia a, haltum thillat leh thaute maitam ah a kangman ta a: huan, mipi tengteng in huai a muh un a kikou zuazua ua, a khupboh khekhup uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to all the people.

paite: Huan, TOUPA ma a kipan mei a hong pawtkhia a, haltum thillat leh thaute maitam ah a kangman ta a: huan, mipi tengteng in huai a muh un a kikou zuazua ua, a khupboh khekhup uhi.
english: There came forth fire from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar: and when all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
